card_line: Same Moon. {name} feels it when you do.
s21_head: You feel things on the same clock.
s21_body: Your Moons sit in the same sign, so your moods rise and settle together. Comfort comes easy, and so does getting stuck in the same mood at the same time.

s21_body: Your Moons make a friendly angle. Small gestures land, and neither of you has to explain why a night in sounds perfect.
s21_try: Ask {name} what makes a place feel like home.

s21_try: Ask {name} what most people get wrong at first.
